---
description: "Use when editing Hugo Markdown content or front matter in content/. Covers safe metadata changes, authentic portfolio voice, and content integrity."
name: "Hugo Content Guidelines"
applyTo: "content/**/*.md"
---

# Hugo Content Guidelines

- Preserve valid Hugo front matter, existing field names, taxonomies, dates, and
  page relationships unless the task explicitly changes them.
- Do not invent personal history, client claims, metrics, credentials, quotes,
  or project outcomes. Ask for missing factual details when necessary.
- Keep the author's direct, professional voice. Preserve intentional Markdown
  structure and verify shortcode or link targets when changing them.
- Run a Hugo build after structural content or front-matter changes.
